Monitoring and privacy. You choose exactly what WorkPulse records, and every employee can see it.
Open Settings, choose the Workspace tab, and scroll down to Activity tracking.
Turn on Track application usage. If you need them, also turn on Record websites, which saves the domain only, and Record window titles.
Turn on Measure keyboard and mouse activity, to count key presses and clicks. It only counts, and never records which keys. Then click Save policy.
Under Screenshots, turn on Capture screenshots, and choose how often. One is taken at a random moment in each interval, only during a work session.
Employees see a red badge on the tray icon whenever screenshots can be taken. Click Save policy.
Under Live screen viewing, turn on Allow live viewing, set the maximum stream length, and click Save policy.
Now open the Monitoring and privacy tab. This page shows everyone what is recorded, when, why, for how long, and who can see it.
It also lists what is never collected, such as what is typed, passwords, and the content of emails and chats.
Done. Your monitoring is set up, openly and fairly.
